transcript: This is Ogie. Ogie's favorite day of the week is Sunday. Because on Sundays, Ogie gets to go on a special adventure. First, Ogie walks all the way across Prospect Park until they reach a magical place. It's called Smorgasburg. Smorgasburg is filled with so many things to see and smell. There are lots of people, dogs, and most importantly, food. Ogie likes to look cute, so people give him treats. Sometimes he makes friends. Today he met Melvin. Melvin is a puppy. Ogie tolerated Melvin until Ogie's mom gave Melvin too much attention. So Ogie jumped on top of the table. She Learned her lesson and gave Ogie lots of treats as an apology. Eventually, it's time to go home. But not before one last round of sniffs. And if he's lucky, he finds extra treats on the ground on the way out. And then they walk all the way home. See you next week, Smorgasburg. Now it's time for a big nap.
classificationReason: A lighthearted narrative vlog about a dog (Ogie) visiting Smorgasburg on a Sunday. Entirely non-theater content.
